FIELDS.NAME: Artisan Haven Studios

FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Artisan Haven Studios operates as a creative space dedicated to various artistic disciplines such as painting, drawing, digital art, and textile crafts. We prioritize safety and sustainability in our operations, exclusively utilizing non-toxic materials and ensuring proper storage and handling procedures are followed. Our facility is equipped with state-of-the-art fire detection and suppression systems, including smoke alarms and sprinklers, to safeguard both our artists and valuable creations. We offer workshops and classes to the public, adhering to established safety protocols and requiring participant waivers to mitigate liability. Additionally, we implement robust cybersecurity measures for our online sales and customer data storage, protecting against potential data breaches. Our studio complies with all local zoning, health, and safety regulations, enhancing our commitment to legal and responsible operation within the community.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any hazardous artistic activities such as glassblowing, welding, or large-scale woodworking, and confirms that all artistic practices are compliant with safety standards. We do not use or store highly toxic, flammable, or volatile chemicals, ensuring all materials are non-toxic or low-toxicity and properly documented for safe handling. Furthermore, our studio is equipped with comprehensive fire detection and suppression systems, including smoke alarms and sprinklers, as required by code.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2023, a minor water leak occurred due to a heavy rainstorm, resulting in damage to several artworks valued at $1,500. The studio conducted an assessment, and all damaged items were restored to their original condition. The status of the loss is resolved.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Secure storage vault, Class 1, fire-rated, locked access, monitored by alarm system.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Secure fencing around the studio perimeter and regular patrolling by a designated watchperson during and after hours to enhance security and prevent unauthorized access.
